description: React Native component for the Restaurant screen, displaying restaurant details, menu sections, and handling user interactions such as adding items to cart, navigation, and UI animations.

methods.name: wrapContentAfterWords
methods.description: Splits content into chunks of specified number of words, joins with line breaks.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Handles adding food items to cart, navigating to item details if multiple variations or addons exist.

methods.name: tagCart
methods.description: Displays cart quantity tag for a specific item if present in cart.

methods.name: scrollToSection
methods.description: Scrolls to a specific section in the menu list.

methods.name: changeIndex
methods.description: Changes selected menu category and scrolls to it.

methods.name: scrollToNavbar
methods.description: Scrolls the category navbar to a specific index.

methods.name: onViewableItemsChanged
methods.description: Updates selected category based on visible items.
